summary.text: Leon Howard is a Democratic state representative from Richland County who has represented South Carolina House District 76 since 1995 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
The owner of an automotive repair business, Howard serves on the House Ways and Means Committee.

paragraphs.text: Howard is president of Howard's Garage, Paint & Body Shop & Wrecker Service, according to his legislative biography.
He holds an associate degree from Midlands Technical College and attended the General Motors Automotive Training Center in Atlanta.
He is a former chairman of the Board of School Commissioners of Richland County School District One.
Howard chaired the South Carolina Legislative Black Caucus in 2007 and 2008 and has chaired the House Medical, Military, Public and Municipal Affairs Committee since 2007, per his official biography.
He sits on the Board of Trustees of Antioch Baptist Church.
